description: One video's labelled frame sheets as images, so you can see the reference instead of guessing from text: the hook (first 3 s at 0.25 s steps), one frame per shot, and the whole film at fixed steps where measured. sheet "transitions" adds every frame around each cut and in-shot change, for timing transitions to the frame. Each image follows a caption saying how its labels read. Accepts the same ids as get_blueprint. Needs a Refs account with Pro; without one, the app asks the user to sign in. search_videos is free.

id.description: REF-0005, a refs.video/v/… link, a YouTube/X link, an id from search_videos, or one of your brand films (brand:<import>:<film>)

sheet.description: Default all (hook, shots and timeline; ask for "transitions" separately)

name: get_frames
title: See a video frame by frame
